title: Ensure SSH is enabled for device management
description: All network device management must use SSH (v2). Telnet transmits credentials in plaintext and must be disabled.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-NET-SSH-001 (custom example rule based on CIS Cisco IOS 17 Benchmark principles)
remediation: Configure 'ip ssh version 2' and remove any 'transport input telnet' lines from VTY lines.

title: Ensure Telnet is disabled on all VTY lines
description: Telnet provides unencrypted access and must not be permitted on any VTY line.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-NET-TELNET-002 (custom example rule based on CIS Cisco IOS 17 Benchmark principles)
remediation: On all VTY lines set 'transport input ssh'. Remove 'transport input telnet' and 'transport input all'.

title: Ensure logging is configured to a remote syslog server
description: Centralised logging provides an audit trail for security events. Devices must ship logs to a remote syslog host.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-NET-LOG-003 (custom example rule based on CIS Cisco IOS 17 Benchmark principles)
remediation: Add 'logging host <syslog-server-ip>' and set 'logging trap informational'.

title: Ensure an access control list restricts management access
description: Management-plane access (SSH, SNMP) should be restricted via an ACL to authorised source networks only.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-NET-ACL-004 (custom example rule based on CIS Cisco IOS 17 Benchmark principles)
remediation: Define a named or numbered ACL that permits only authorised management hosts and apply it to VTY lines with 'access-class'.

title: Ensure a login warning banner is configured
description: A warning banner informs users that the device is for authorised use only and that activity may be monitored.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-NET-BANNER-005 (custom example rule based on CIS Cisco IOS 17 Benchmark principles)
remediation: Configure 'banner login ^C <warning text> ^C' with appropriate legal notice language.

title: Ensure SNMPv1 and SNMPv2c community strings are not default
description: Default SNMP community strings ('public', 'private') are widely known and must be changed or SNMP disabled.
benchmark_reference: ILLUSTRATIVE-NET-SNMP-006 (custom example rule based on CIS Cisco IOS 17 Benchmark principles)
remediation: Remove default community strings with 'no snmp-server community public' and 'no snmp-server community private'. Prefer SNMPv3.
